The registration fee must be paid until  02/01/2025, it shows the commitment of the competitor's participation and this information is used for planning and organizing the competition, therefore it is not refundable. **Your registration will not be complete until payment confirmation, which must be made via PIX.**

**PIX (E-mail): henrique_rojas@hotmail.com
Account holder: Henrique Rojas Moreno de Almeida
Bank: Nubank**
